detailed_description:
The target video is a 10-second continuous hyper-realistic cinematic action sequence, smooth 24fps motion, dynamic but coherent camera movement, realistic anatomy, believable weight transfer, physical impact absorption, large-scale dragon creature physics, persistent dust and debris.
- From 00:00.000 to 00:01.500: Extreme close-up on Wukong’s hands gripping Ruyi Jingu Bang. The staff ignites with intense golden-orange energy, crackling and continuously pulsing; faint emerald green sparks begin to flicker along the edge. Camera slowly orbits the staff, shallow depth of field, warm dusk rim light, deep shadows.
- From 00:01.500 to 00:03.000: The glowing golden staff collides violently with the heavy sweeping tail of the colossal eastern dragon. Bright golden-green energy detonation, stone shards, shockwave, dust cloud and glowing particles explode outward. Camera whips fast along the impact direction, strong motion blur at the moment of collision then re-establishes focus.
- From 00:03.000 to 00:04.000: Tight close-up on Wukong’s face: dusty fur and skin, long black wind-tousled mane, burning golden eyes, firm fierce determined expression. The charging staff passes in the foreground, casting green and golden light across his face, wind blows his mane, dust and grit details on armor.
- From 00:04.000 to 00:05.500: Wide establishing shot of the vast dusty ruined arena under storm clouds. Armored Wukong lands in a low battle stance, golden energy trailing from Jingu Bang. Opposite him stands a colossal black-silver scaled eastern dragon with sharp antlers, emerald glowing eyes, dragon maw dripping swirling golden energy. Dust fog surges around both combatants, epic IMAX scale, golden dusk haze and deep shadows.
- From 00:05.500 to 00:07.000: Fast action sequence. Wukong dashes forward, leaps and delivers blazing continuous staff strikes. Golden energy trails slice through the air, dragon roars and swings its massive tail and claws. Dynamic tracking and orbiting camera capture sparks, heavy impacts, shockwaves and expanding dust clouds. Both sides exchange blows as equals, no one-sided domination.
- From 00:07.000 to 00:08.200: Low-angle shot. Wukong leaps over the dragon’s antlers, raising the golden-glowing Jingu Bang high against the stormy sky. Dragon lowers its head, tenses muscles and charges straight toward Wukong, emerald eyes blazing, epic silhouette, golden dusk backlight.
- From 00:08.200 to 00:10.000: High-speed head-on collision. Wukong’s golden-emerald staff slams directly against the dragon’s horned skull. Massive spherical shockwave bursts outward, stone floor cracks and rubble flies everywhere. Dragon’s scales splinter, head violently recoils backward; Wukong is thrown back slightly by the force. Camera shakes intensely from the collision. Dense dust and glowing particles explode and fill the frame. After the impact, dust slowly billows, both combatants stagger apart, frame fades to black.
overall_soundscape:
Jingu Bang energy ignition, low roaring staff hum, cracking metal-on-scale impact, golden-green detonation boom, shockwave thunder, stone debris, deep dragon roar, warbling emerald eye energy crackle, deep arena wind, deafening head-on collision boom, ground fracture rumble. No background music.

No dialogue, no subtitles, no UI, no text, no watermark. No Wukong identity change, no armor reset, no staff transformation, no dragon anatomy change, no environment reset. No weightless motion, no floating limbs, no body interpenetration, no staff clipping, no blank expression, no static mane or clothes, no vanishing effects, no extra characters.
